text:
zoe: Postmortem follow-up: turning recurring patterns into a prioritized action list. Short messages please — claim items with "+1" and ETA.

zoe: TL;DR: brief routing instability during a maintenance window -> missed cross-region snapshot -> complicated partial restores. Recurring theme: long DNS/TTL + manual restore steps.

devon: I'll pick up snapshot verification and retention edge-cases. Plan: add a fast validation job that compares manifest checksums across regions and a one-off backfill for missed snapshots. ETA quick win 5d.

ana: (ana) I'll do the restore tooling improvements: add a dry-run flag that simulates partial restores and outputs a deterministic reconciliation plan. Will PR the CLI change. ETA 2w.

ajay: Routing owner here. Action: implement a pre-push canary that verifies BGP table stability and a fallback route that kicks in automatically if route convergence exceeds 30s. Need infra review for the automation. ETA prototype 1w.

maria: I'll rewrite the runbook to include explicit post-maintenance checks (TTL ramp-down, snapshot sanity, KV warming). Also add a one-page cheat-sheet for on-call. PR incoming.

zoe: Owners summary: snapshots=devon, restore-tooling=ana, routing=ajay, runbook=maria. I'll create cards and assign.

devon: Quick example check for reviewers (will add to BOARD-1182):

```
# verify manifests match across regions
aws s3 cp s3://backups/us-west/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/us-manifest
ssh eu "aws s3 cp s3://backups/eu/manifest.json - | jq -S ." > /tmp/eu-manifest
diff -u /tmp/us-manifest /tmp/eu-manifest || echo "mismatch"
```

ana: CLI dry-run idea: `rb-restore --dry-run --region eu --preview-only` prints actions without touching DBs. Will include sample output in PR.

ajay: Routing proto repo: https://git/repo/routing-safepush. Tagging eng-infra for review. Note: we should also consider a short DNS TTL policy for maintenance windows.

maria: Runbook PR: https://git/repo/runbooks/pull/89 026-04-01 diff. Added checkpoint: "verify cross-region manifest parity" and a rollback paragraph.

incident-bot: Created task INC-2026-314: "DR follow-ups: snapshot + routing + runbook" and scheduled a 2026-04-11T15:00Z sync.

zoe: Game-day suggestion: two-stage rehearsal: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-13 (no data moves), then full data failover 2026-04-20. Can owners confirm availability?

devon: 04-13 dry-run ok, will run checksum job beforehand.

ana: 04-13 ok for dry-run; 04-20 tentative but should be fine.

ajay: 04-20 can make the full run-through, will prioritize the routing fallback test.

maria: both dates OK, will bring runbook updates to the dry-run.

zoe: Final ask: reply with owner + firm ETA so I can update trackers.

devon: snapshots validation + backfill plan -> ETA 2026-04-09. +1

ana: restore tooling dry-run flag + CLI PR -> ETA 2026-04-15. +1

ajay: routing canary + fallback automation prototype -> ETA 2026-04-07. +1

maria: runbook merge + cheat-sheet -> ETA 2026-04-06. +1

zoe: Thanks everyone. I'll populate INC-2026-314 and BOARD-1182, and post the sync invite. If anything slips, bump this thread and we'll escalate to the DR rota. :thumbsup:
